name: CET-6 示例词书
description: 示例数据：取自 ECDICT（MIT 许可），仅用于试用学习流程。

words.translation: vt. 放弃, 抛弃, 遗弃, 使屈从, 沉溺, 放纵\nn. 放任, 无拘束, 狂热
words.definition:
n. the trait of lacking restraint or control; reckless freedom from inhibition or worry
v. forsake, leave behind
v. give up with the intent of never claiming again
v. stop maintaining or insisting on; of ideas or claims

words.translation: vt. 废止, 革除, 消灭\n[经] 废除, 取消, 裁撤
words.definition: v. do away with

words.translation: a. 突然的, 唐突的, 陡峭的, 不连贯的
words.definition:
s. marked by sudden changes in subject and sharp transitions
s. exceedingly sudden and unexpected
s. extremely steep
s. surprisingly and unceremoniously brusque in manner

words.translation: a. 荒谬的, 不合理的, 可笑的\nn. 荒诞
words.definition: n. a situation in which life seems irrational and meaningless\ns. inconsistent with reason or logic or common sense\ns. incongruous; inviting ridicule

words.translation: vt. 使适应, 调和, 通融, 容纳, 向...提供\nvi. 适应
words.definition: v. provide with something desired or needed\nv. have room for; hold without crowding\nv. make (one thing) compatible with (another)

words.translation: v. 积聚, 堆积
words.definition: v. collect or gather

words.translation: a. 正确的, 精确的\n[经] 准确的, 精确的
words.definition: a. conforming exactly or almost exactly to fact or to a standard or performing with total accuracy\ns. (of ideas, images, representations, expressions) characterized by perfect conformity to fact or truth; strictly correct

words.translation: a. 惯常的, 习惯了的
words.definition: a. (often followed by `to') in the habit of or adapted to\ns. commonly used or practiced; usual

words.translation: vt. 获得, 学到\n[电] 目标锁定
words.definition: v. locate (a moving entity) by means of a tracking system such as radar\nv. win something through one's efforts

words.translation: a. 适当的, 足够的\n[法] 胜任的, 适当的, 充分的
words.definition: a. having the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task\ns. sufficient for the purpose\ns. about average; acceptable

words.translation: vt. 调整, 使适应于, 校准\nvi. 适应于, 被调节, 相互熟悉而适应
words.definition:
v. alter or regulate so as to achieve accuracy or conform to a standard
v. adapt or conform oneself to new or different conditions
v. make correspondent or conformable
v. decide how much is to be paid on an insurance claim

words.translation: n. 行政, 管理, 政府机关\n[化] 给药
words.definition:
n. a method of tending to or managing the affairs of a some group of people (especially the group's business affairs)
n. the persons (or committees or departments etc.) who make up a body for the purpose of administering something
n. the act of administering medication
n. the act of meting out justice according to the law

words.translation: n. 提倡者, 拥护者\nvt. 主张, 提倡
words.definition: n. a person who pleads for a cause or propounds an idea\nn. a lawyer who pleads cases in court

words.translation: a. 美学的, 审美的, 有美感的
words.definition:
n. (philosophy) a philosophical theory as to what is beautiful
a. relating to or dealing with the subject of aesthetics
a. concerning or characterized by an appreciation of beauty or good taste
s. aesthetically pleasing

words.translation: n. 影响, 病, 喜爱, 情感, 倾向\n[医] 疾患, 病变, 病; 感情
words.definition: n. a positive feeling of liking

words.translation: a. 侵略的, 挑畔的, 进取的\n[法] 侵略的, 爱挑衅的, 行为过火的
words.definition: a. having or showing determination and energetic pursuit of your ends; positive in his convictions"\ns. tending to spread quickly\ns. characteristic of an enemy or one eager to fight

words.translation: n. 农业\n[机] 农业, 农学
words.definition: n. the class of people engaged in growing food

words.translation: vt. 分派, 分配\n[计] 分配
words.definition: v. distribute according to a plan or set apart for a special purpose

words.translation: a. 不明确的, 模棱两可的\n[法] 意思含糊的, 模棱两可的, 暧昧的
words.definition: a. having more than one possible meaning\ns. having no intrinsic or objective meaning; not organized in conventional patterns

words.translation: a. 有野心的, 抱负不凡的, 雄心勃勃的
words.definition: a. having a strong desire for success or achievement\ns. requiring full use of your abilities or resources

words.translation: vt. 分析, 细察, 分解\n[机] 分析
words.definition: v. consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning\nv. make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of; break down into components or essential features\nv. break down into components or essential features

words.translation: a. 古代的, 古老的, 年老的, 旧的
words.definition:
n. a very old person
n. a person who lived in ancient times
s. belonging to times long past especially of the historical period before the fall of the Western Roman Empire
s. very old

words.translation: n. 周年纪念
words.definition: n. the date on which an event occurred in some previous year (or the celebration of it)

words.translation: vt. 预期, 占先, 加速, 提前使用\n[医] 提前出现, 先期发生
words.definition:
v. act in advance of; deal with ahead of time
v. realize beforehand
v. be excited or anxious about
v. be a forerunner of or occur earlier than

words.translation: a. 清晰可见的, 显然的, 表面上的\n[电] 外在的
words.definition: s. clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment\ns. appearing as such but not necessarily so

words.translation: n. 恳求, 诉请, 上诉, 吸引力\nvi. 呼吁, 诉请, 要求, 上诉, 有吸引力\nvt. 将...上诉
words.definition:
n. attractiveness that interests or pleases or stimulates
n. (law) a legal proceeding in which the appellant resorts to a higher court for the purpose of obtaining a review of a lower court decision and a reversal of the lower court's judgment or the granting of a new trial
v. take a court case to a higher court for review
v. request earnestly (something from somebody); ask for aid or protection

words.translation: vt. 赏识, 鉴别, 为...而感激, 领会, 欣赏\nvi. 增值, 涨价
words.definition:
v. recognize with gratitude; be grateful for
v. be fully aware of; realize fully
v. gain in value
v. increase the value of

words.translation: n. 接近, 入门\nvt. 接近, 近似, 找...商量\nvi. 靠近
words.definition:
n. ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation
n. the act of drawing spatially closer to something
n. the event of one object coming closer to another
n. the temporal property of becoming nearer in time

words.translation: adv. 大约, 大致, 近于\n[经] 大约, 近似
words.definition: r. (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct

words.translation: a. 任意的, 武断的, 专治的, 霸道的
words.definition: a. based on or subject to individual discretion or preference or sometimes impulse or caprice
